naming_ban: Do not write 'order flow predicts' for OHLCV-derived fields.

source.construction: Volume-based front-month continuous: per calendar date keep the single-contract symbol with maximum daily volume; drop spreads (symbols containing '-'); no back-adjustment of prices across rolls (see archive/legacy_scripts/build_continuous_data.py).

clocks.decision_T: End of completed bar with open=ts. Features use that bar's OHLCV and history with open < ts+1m. Outcomes use closes after this bar.

volume_definition: Databento OHLCV-1m contract volume for the selected front-month symbol in that minute. Unsigned. Continuous series has volume_min=1 (no zeros observed in audit).

missing_zero_handling.volume_eq_0: If ever present: impact ratios NaN; signed_vol_proxy uses sign(ret)*0=0 when ret finite
missing_zero_handling.ret_across_gap: ret_1m set NaN when prior bar gap > 1.01 minutes
missing_zero_handling.roll_days: Symbol changes retained; returns across gaps NaN; document roll contamination risk

contemporaneous_vs_lagged.features_at_T: OHLCV of bar ending at T (includes same-bar ret_1m inside signed_vol_proxy)
contemporaneous_vs_lagged.outcomes: close[T+h]/close[T]-1 and path stats on (T, T+h] — excludes using future bars as features
contemporaneous_vs_lagged.strict: Do not use outcome-horizon returns as features

proxies_frozen.vol_z_tod: (volume - Discovery mean volume at same ny_min) / Discovery std at same ny_min; RTH only; Discovery years only for moments; applied unchanged to Val/OOS
proxies_frozen.signed_vol_proxy: sign(ret_1m)*volume; sign(0)=0; NaN if ret_1m NaN. NOT aggressor flow.
proxies_frozen.signed_vol_proxy_sum_5: sum of signed_vol_proxy over bars t-4..t (same session, require 5 finite)
proxies_frozen.signed_vol_proxy_resid: residual of signed_vol_proxy ~ ret_1m + absret_1m + range_pct with intercept; coefficients fit on Discovery RTH only; applied to all splits
proxies_frozen.es_nq_rel_ret_1m: ES ret_1m - NQ ret_1m on aligned minute (secondary)

outcomes_frozen.ret_h: close[t+h]/close[t]-1 if both bars exist and span is usable
outcomes_frozen.rv_h: std of 1m returns on (t, t+h] * sqrt(n), require n>=3
outcomes_frozen.mfe_h: max(high path)/close[t]-1 on bars with open in (t, t+h]
outcomes_frozen.mae_h: min(low path)/close[t]-1 on bars with open in (t, t+h]

splits.tercile_cuts: Discovery RTH equal-frequency only; applied unchanged

hard_bans: no Delta-R2 until Phase 1 descriptives reviewed
